prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce ONE 1024 x 1024 RGBA transparent PNG, a left-side albedo texture-source painting for An Overseer's perch.

INPUT ROLES: Image 1, guide_left.png, is the EDIT TARGET and absolute geometry/composition authority. Image 2, design_reference.png, supplies only the approved materials and colours. Image 3, concept_crop.png, is secondary concept context only; do not include its character or scenery.

Edit Image 1 IN PLACE by painting its existing visible surfaces. Keep its exact orthographic LEFT view, identical silhouette, every shape edge, opening, detail, position and scale. Preserve the original transparency mask exactly, including all interior openings and all antialiased contour edges. Keep the object in precisely the existing 1024-square framing, approximately x=262..761, y=66..957. Do not rotate, reframe, shift, stretch, smooth the angular geometry or crop it. The narrow near-edge vertical ladder/strip stays on the RIGHT as in this left guide. The upper solid panel and its pointed arch relief remain solid where the guide is solid; transparent holes between supports and braces stay exactly where they are. All feet, tapered pylons, cross-braces, rails and spikes retain the guide shapes. Do not replace the guide with the three-quarter design reference. Add no ornament geometry, rubble, extra supports or spikes.

Paint the reference material design onto ONLY these existing shapes: black-violet resin struts, arch frames and roots; aged white ceramic pylon panels with subtle fine cracks and brushed gold bands; warm ivory bone ribs and top spikes; orange inset light strip and orange inset sacs/seams only within existing surfaces; dark worn alloy deck plates. Follow the guide's surfaces for material boundaries. Surface markings may describe the design but must not alter any geometry. Use the design reference's distinct dark violet, white/ivory, muted gold and saturated orange palette.

LIGHTING: This is an ALBEDO / BASE COLOUR texture source, not a beauty render. Even, flat, shadowless illumination from the viewer across ALL surfaces. No cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no rim light, no directional light falloff. Orange luminous parts are painted their bright orange material colour without bloom, halos or cast orange light on neighbouring surfaces. Material grain and fine wear only, no baked lighting.

Background and all guide openings must be truly transparent (alpha=0), not black or a painted checkerboard. No background, floor, ground shadow, text, border, labels or watermark. Return the raw unresized 1024 x 1024 image.
reason: Rejected in favour of attempt 2: excessive baked shading/specular detail and silhouette drift. Native return also fails requested 1024 x 1024 size.

checks.materials_and_colours: Matches the requested black-violet resin, light ceramic, ivory, gold and orange palette; surface details are generatively interpreted.
checks.clean_alpha_edges: Transparent background is present; sparse low-alpha pixels extend beyond the main silhouette.
checks.comparison_note: Normalized pixel-centre sampling for measurement only; no output image was resized, re-encoded or altered.
